raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00), so about 327 rows are exact re-deliveries with the same txn_id. The silver step has no deduplication, which inflates silver and every gold table built from it. txn_ids are contiguous (900001–904827) and all extra rows sit in batch 13, so deduplicating by txn_id is safe.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
